event.description: Encode digits with Chebyshev features and independent control-token indicators
event.proposal: Family token representation (8 prior: attempts 0005, 0013-0017, 0107; current retained 1672 parameters at 99.01%, +0.01 over the 99% threshold). Most recent accepted same-family result was attempt 0016 at 3376 parameters/99.18%; most recent failed result was attempt 0107, whose rank-6 token factor scored 0.02% at 1655 parameters. Fit the retained 12x16 tied token matrix to an 11-feature task-aligned basis: digit rows use Chebyshev orders 0-8 and the two control tokens get independent indicators, giving 1663 total parameters. This is more informative than the nearest untested rank-7/8 generic factorization because it preserves rank up to 11, isolates whether numeric order is exploitable, and risks only nine parameters while directly addressing the rank-6 collapse.
